description: This file declares structures, functions, and constants related to merged reference tables in a version control system. It provides an interface for creating, initializing, and managing merged tables that present a unified view over multiple immutable reference tables.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_new
methods.description: Creates a new merged table from a list of individual tables, maintaining their lifetime.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_init_ref_iterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator over the reference entries in the merged table.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_init_log_iterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator over log entries in the merged table.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_max_update_index
methods.description: Returns the maximum update index covered by the merged table.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_min_update_index
methods.description: Returns the minimum update index covered by the merged table.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_free
methods.description: Releases memory associated with the merged table.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_hash_id
methods.description: Returns the hash ID associated with the merged table.
